newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Port conditions update-Sri Lanka - Lloyds Shipping.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update-Sri Lanka - Lloyds Shipping.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

COLOMBO, Sept 23 - 12 container dischargers/loaders, one food discharger, one general cargo discharger, one fertiliser discharger, one bulk discharger and three general cargo loaders working. Three container vessels, one food discharger, one cement discharger, one fertiliser and one LPG gas discharger awaiting berths.
